limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses a mouse model of LPS-induced neuroinflammation, which may not fully recapitulate human neuroinflammatory conditions.
The causal role of C1q is inferred from neutralization antibody experiments; genetic knockout or knockdown studies were not performed.
The study focuses on hippocampal CA1 region; other brain regions may be affected differently.
